source.format: 16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV, individual headset microphones

range.chosen_by: 30 s windows ranked by seconds of 100 ms frames in which each headset was the loudest and within 12 dB of its own 95th-percentile level: 4.8 s (headset 0), 2.6 s, 4.6 s and 3.0 s (headsets 1-3), so all three remote speakers talk; both ends moved to the quietest 10 ms nearby

mix: per channel: sum the sources' 16-bit samples, multiply by gain, round half to even, clip to 16 bits (the far sum peaks at 1.121 of full scale over the range; 0.88 keeps it under)
notes: Individual headsets hear the other talkers faintly (crosstalk), so the far channel carries headset 0's voice some 20 dB down, and the mic channel the others'. A real system tap would not.
